cpmplus.w6help.skel.legend: Accent colour: body parts (labelled). Dashed: copy of a body part (_dup). Grey: equipment roots (cape, elytra, armor). Green with a hand: item slot. Red: not exported / unknown root. Thin neutral line: your own groups. Click a label to select the group.
cpmplus.w6help.skel.notCpm: The skeleton only works in CPM projects
cpmplus.w6help.skel.animHint: Skeleton in Animate mode: Minecraft's own swing is not shown here; CPM adds it in game.
cpmplus.w6help.part.head: Head
